Heaven’s Gate at golden hour. The twin hills below look exactly how the locals describe them.
Fog sat in the valley until 8. Worth getting up cold for.

Homestay dinner. Too much rice wine and a toast every four minutes.
Ma Pi Leng Pass before the tour groups. Had the whole road to myself.
Boat through the canyon. Water that colour should not be legal.

Auntie’s ridge path. Trust her, not the map.

Smooth main loop, rough near Du Gia.

Village dogs bark a lot. Give them space and they lose interest.
Nights drop to 8°. Snacks for the passes.
